mapper.select: SELECT RID, CUID, UID, Rating, Comment, Status, CreateTime FROM course_ratings WHERE CUID = #{cuid} AND UID = #{uid} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_ratings (CUID, UID, Rating, Comment, Status, CreateTime) VALUES (#{cuid}, #{uid}, #{rating}, #{comment}, #{status}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE Rating = VALUES(Rating), Comment = VALUES(Comment), Status = VALUES(Status), CreateTime = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT r.RID, r.CUID, r.UID, r.Rating, r.Comment, r.Status, r.CreateTime, u.UserName AS userName FROM course_ratings r INNER JOIN users u ON r.UID = u.UID WHERE r.CUID = #{cuid} AND r.Status = 1 ORDER BY r.CreateTime DESC, r.RID DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ratingCount, ROUND(AVG(Rating), 1) AS avgRating FROM course_ratings WHERE CUID = #{cuid} AND Status = 1
